reviews.comment:
Una total falta de respeto a los miles de turistas que pasan a diario.
Una larguísima cola en el kiosco donde tenes que esperar porque Una sola persona atiende para todo y todos, hasta por la ficha de $300 para agua del mate, tenes que hacer la cola, cuando en otras estaciones de servicio el agua caliente es gratis.
Saca la cuenta, estuve 30 minutos en la cola y éramos 20personas con termos, a $300 la ficha.....

(Translated by Google)
A total lack of respect for the thousands of tourists who pass through daily.
There's an incredibly long line at the kiosk where you have to wait because only one person serves everyone and everything, even for the $300 token for hot water for mate. You have to wait in line, while at other gas stations hot water is free. Do the math: I was in line for 30 minutes, and there were 20 of us with thermoses, at $300 per token...
